ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. It is released when the game loses focus.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game when its window loses focus.
plugin.name: Hidden & Dangerous 2 Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup logo videos and the intro movie (it stays in Films). Needs a restart.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the field of view of the gameplay camera. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values show more. Cutscenes keep their framing.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the fix's texts, such as the update notice. Automatic uses the game language and falls back to English.
FMVMode.description: Original shows movies as the game does, inside the 4:3 frame. Fill shows the whole movie as large as the screen allows, at its own aspect ratio.
WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, a framed window or a borderless desktop-sized window. Restart the game to apply.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto keeps the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape.
CutsceneBorders.description: Cutscenes are framed for 16:9. Letterbox keeps the game's bars above and below on narrower screens; Pillarbox keeps the 16:9 picture between side bars on wider screens; Both does both and shows the original framing everywhere; Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and shows it in the version line of the menus; FusionFixHub then opens when you close the game. Off makes no network request.
